title: Practice 3: Two verbs for every way of going

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Ты ___ (ехать — to go by vehicle, ride, one way; impf., pres. 2nd sg.) в Рио на Олимпиаду?
exercises.why: **едешь** — present tense (2nd person singular) of ехать: one-direction verb (many directions: ездить).
exercises.prompt: Are you coming to Rio for the Olympics?

exercises.q: Над водой ___ (летать — to fly, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 3rd pl.) чайки.
exercises.why: **летают** — present tense (3rd person plural) of летать: many-directions verb (one direction: лететь).
exercises.prompt: Seagulls fly over the water.

exercises.q: Вы ___ (ехать — to go by vehicle, ride, one way; impf., pres. 2nd pl.) в отпуск на Сицилию?
exercises.why: **едете** — present tense (2nd person plural) of ехать: one-direction verb (many directions: ездить).
exercises.prompt: Are you going on vacation in Sicily?

exercises.q: Она ___ (ходить — to go, walk, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 3rd sg.) на каблуках.
exercises.why: **ходит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of ходить: many-directions verb (one direction: идти).
exercises.prompt: She's wearing high heels.

exercises.q: Он не ___ (ходить — to go, walk, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 3rd sg.) в церковь.
exercises.why: **ходит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of ходить: many-directions verb (one direction: идти).
exercises.prompt: He doesn't go to church.

exercises.q: Он редко ___ (ходить — to go, walk, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 3rd sg.) в кино.
exercises.why: **ходит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of ходить: many-directions verb (one direction: идти).
exercises.prompt: He rarely goes to the movies.

exercises.q: Кен ___ (ходить — to go, walk, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 3rd sg.) на костылях.
exercises.why: **ходит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of ходить: many-directions verb (one direction: идти).
exercises.prompt: Ken is walking on crutches.

exercises.q: Прогресс в медицине ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way; impf., pres. 3rd sg.) семимильными шагами.
exercises.why: **идет** — present tense (3rd person singular) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).
exercises.prompt: Progress in medicine is going ahead by leaps and bounds.

exercises.q: Не ___ (ходить — to go, walk, there and back or in general; impf., imper. pl.) дома в халате!
exercises.why: **ходите** — present tense (2nd person plural) of ходить: many-directions verb (one direction: идти).
exercises.prompt: Don't walk around the house in a bathrobe.

exercises.q: Твои дети ___ (ходить — to go, walk, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 3rd pl.) в садик?
exercises.why: **ходят** — present tense (3rd person plural) of ходить: many-directions verb (one direction: идти).
exercises.prompt: Do your children go to kindergarten?

exercises.q: Поезда ___ (ходить — to go, walk, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 3rd pl.) по рельсам.
exercises.why: **ходят** — present tense (3rd person plural) of ходить: many-directions verb (one direction: идти).
exercises.prompt: Trains run on rails.

exercises.q: Мои кошки ___ (ходить — to go, walk, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 3rd pl.) в лоток.
exercises.why: **ходят** — present tense (3rd person plural) of ходить: many-directions verb (one direction: идти).
exercises.prompt: My cats use a litter box to go to the restroom.

exercises.q: Наши соседи ___ (ехать — to go by vehicle, ride, one way; impf., pres. 3rd pl.) в июле на Балтику.
exercises.why: **едут** — present tense (3rd person plural) of ехать: one-direction verb (many directions: ездить).
exercises.prompt: Our neighbours are travelling to the Baltic Sea in July.

exercises.q: Пешки ___ (ходить — to go, walk, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 3rd pl.) только вперёд.
exercises.why: **ходят** — present tense (3rd person plural) of ходить: many-directions verb (one direction: идти).
exercises.prompt: Pawns only move forward.

exercises.q: Ты ___ (ходить — to go, walk, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 2nd sg.) в начальную школу?
exercises.why: **ходишь** — present tense (2nd person singular) of ходить: many-directions verb (one direction: идти).
exercises.prompt: Do you go to an elementary school?

exercises.q: Ты поди часто на матчи ___ (ходить — to go, walk, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 2nd sg.).
exercises.why: **ходишь** — present tense (2nd person singular) of ходить: many-directions verb (one direction: идти).
exercises.prompt: You must go to matches often.

exercises.q: Что это вы ___ (ходить — to go, walk, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 2nd pl.) взад и вперёд?
exercises.why: **ходите** — present tense (2nd person plural) of ходить: many-directions verb (one direction: идти).
exercises.prompt: Why are you pacing up and down?

exercises.q: Он ___ (ездить — to go by vehicle, ride, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 3rd sg.) очень быстро.
exercises.why: **ездит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of ездить: many-directions verb (one direction: ехать).
exercises.prompt: He drives very fast.

exercises.q: Я часто ___ (ездить — to go by vehicle, ride, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 1st sg.) в Лондон.
exercises.why: **езжу** — present tense (1st person singular) of ездить: many-directions verb (one direction: ехать).
exercises.prompt: I often go to London.

exercises.q: Я часто ___ (ездить — to go by vehicle, ride, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 1st sg.) в Бостон.
exercises.why: **езжу** — present tense (1st person singular) of ездить: many-directions verb (one direction: ехать).
exercises.prompt: I often go to Boston.
